descriptionHtml:
Approach · TC-20 Rounding Dashboard · S03 Hospital: a mixed census matches the list, rows show the right room and open-task count, and list search/sort does not leak into the dashboard

UAT steps / ticket ACs covered:

  • U1 With patients in a mix of pending / in-progress / complete states, the dashboard counts (Total, Pending, In Progress, Complete) match the real patient-list state, in Hospital and in Nursing Home (UAT TC-20; TFA-92598 AC 3) — gate: blocked: TFA-92598 in progress
  • U2 The dashboard is present (reachable from the patient list) and correct in both Hospital and Nursing Home (UAT TC-20; TFA-92598 AC 5) — gate: blocked: TFA-92598 in progress
  • T3 The app counts every patient in Total and in exactly one of Pending (not yet prepped), In Progress and Complete, and shows the counts prominently (TFA-92598 How it works 1; TFA-92598 How it works 2) — gate: blocked: TFA-92598 in progress

Test design technique: Happy path (happy-path) — Walk the normal flow exactly as the UAT / ticket words it; everything it names has to show up.

Given Seeded Hospital census of 5 patients in clear states (2 pending, 1 pre-rounded, 1 seen, 1 post-rounded). H1 has 2 open tasks and 1 done task; H2 has 1 open task. The standard Nursing Home resident, and 1 pending patient owned by a second @roundai.test physician

When Open the Hospital list and wait for every card. Type H1's first name into the list search and change the sort order once. Then open the Rounding Dashboard from the list

Then The list header shows 1 of 5 done. The dashboard ignores the list's search and sort: Total 5, Pending 2, In Progress 2, Complete 1, and all five patients listed. H1's row reads 'Room 401 · 2 tasks pending' (done task not counted) and H2's 'Room 402 · 1 task pending' (singular). Neither the Nursing Home resident nor the other physician's patient appears

Pass rule (oracle, excerpt): From UAT TC-20 'counts accurately match real patient list state', ticket rule 1 (Pending = not yet prepped; pre-rounded and seen are in progress; marked complete is complete), the dashboard's own rule that it is independent of list search and sort, and the p72 prototype row ('Room N · N task(s) pending', open tasks only). …

Where it ran: datasets (seeded data sets, list checks) on dev; test method PW · Playwright script; lane planned in the matrix: browser agent (blocked)

S03 is our own case number (its number in the coverage matrix cases/TC-20.matrix.json), not a step number of the UAT document.

Environment: dev — dev deployment, build e02167f (Deploy Convex, 2026-10-12T18:24:27Z); account and address are not written into the report; run folder runs/2026-10-14-dev, lane datasets (datasets/results.json, screenshots not attached).

Test method: PW · Playwright script; secondary: AGENT · Browser agent — as classified in cases/test-methods.json, which says it runs on both; Source: dev/datasets.
